name: Heating Control
description: A site's heating / cooling on water: air / water heat pumps charge buffer tanks, the rooms' fan coils draw from them. Auto heating / cooling by the outdoor temperature (hysteresis) or set by hand; the tanks' start / stop band; room thermostats. Simulated from the weather forecast (COP, tanks, rooms); today's heat, electricity and money with the baselines (direct electric heating, heat pumps without tanks). Commands, WEM, time series, AI tool heating.status. Uses weather-control and energy-grid.
